top_signals.title: US Stocks Gain as Investors Parse Anthropic IPO Filing
top_signals.summary: US stocks gained on Monday as investors digest Anthropic PBC’s filing for its initial public offering and look forward to key big tech earnings this week as well as the Federal Reserve’s next decision on Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Revolut founder accused of hatching a ‘scheme’ to avoid fees in superyacht row
top_signals.summary: The billionaire founder of Revolut has been accused of hatching a “scheme” to avoid paying brokerage fees in a row over a superyacht said to cost €350m. top_signals.title: AI Is a Choice
top_signals.summary: Alex Imas, Mohamed El-Erian, and James Manyika, leading voices at the intersection of business and technology, argue that realizing AI’s potential requires giving workers, communities, AI labs, infrastructure developers, and big companies a share of the gains. Using insights from game theory, they argue that increased cooperation can make AI work for all.
